observations: LuaTimedActionNew constructor tests the action metatable complete field. Absent complete selects custom/local synchronization; a defined complete selects native NetTimedAction dispatch.
Native NetTimedAction.getDuration multiplies the Lua action duration by 20 ms after native adjustment. LuaTimedActionNew converts native duration back using division by 20 for client progress.
NetTimedAction.perform calls Lua complete; local LuaTimedActionNew.perform calls Lua perform. Vanilla shared bandaging separates mutation into complete; client medical check defines perform only.
Current mod validation was tested offline only. Native object reconstruction, timing modifiers and dedicated replication remain unverified.
